item: 1.32 follow-up — with a suggestion showing and the box empty, Ctrl+Enter and the Send button send the suggestion; Tab still only writes it in; the placeholder says both (2026-11-25)
branch: js/60-composer.js setSuggestion (placeholder 'Suggestion: <text>   (Ctrl+Enter to send, Tab to edit)') · submit(): an empty box with no attachments takes the suggestion as the text
provenance: The prompt_suggestion frame is the CLI's own shape, taped 2026-11-22 on 2.1.330 (fixture 112); the suggestion texts are invented. Ctrl+Enter is a synthetic keydown on #input and the click is S.click(), both of which run our handlers (what is under test). window.__bridge is wrapped around every send, so no turn reaches the CLI; the 'user' frames it would have sent are what is asserted. Each step resets with setBusy(false) + __clear. The attachment is a hand-made entry in the composer's own `pending` list.

steps.note: the placeholder names both keys; Ctrl+Enter in the empty box sends the suggestion
